Resolution No. 2026-06

A RESOLUTION OF THE MAYOR AND CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF WHITE FOR THE PURPOSE OF ESTABLISHING A SCHEDULE OF FEES AND CHARGES PURSUANT TO THE ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WHITE, GEORGIA.

WHEREAS, The Mayor and City Council adopted the Alcoholic Beverages ordinance (hereinafter referred to as “Ordinance”) of the City of White at the regularly called meeting of the Mayor and Council on February 2, 2026; and

WHEREAS, the Ordinance provides that certain fees and charges related to the Ordinance be set by resolution of the Mayor and City Council;

NOW THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED, and it is hereby resolved by the Mayor and City

Council of the City of White, that the attached Addendum “A” is the schedule of fees and charges of the City of White, Georgia under the Alcoholic Beverages Ordinance of the City of

White, Georgia. SO RESOLVED this 2 nd day of }@ , 2026.
